name: node_embedding_similarity
author: 4ebce3f0
description: Finds the nodes whose position in the network is most similar to a given node, using DeepWalk-style embeddings: random walks over the graph train a vector for every node (skip-gram with negative sampling), and nodes are compared by cosine similarity of their vectors. Use it for questions like 'which nodes play a similar role to X?', 'which airports are most like Chennai in the route network?' or 'how similar are X and Y?' (give Y as target). Nodes that are near each other or share many neighbours score high, even without a direct edge. Works on undirected and directed graphs (direction ignored); weights are ignored. Results are approximate and depend on seed (default 0, so repeat calls agree). Returns the top_k most similar nodes with scores from -1 to 1 and whether each is a direct neighbour, plus the target's score and rank if given.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

node.description: Exact id of the node to find similar nodes for (use lookup_node to find it).

top_k.description: How many similar nodes to return.

target.description: Optional exact id of a second node; the result then gives its similarity to 'node' and its rank.

seed.description: Random seed for the walks and training; the same seed gives the same result.

dimensions.description: Length of each node's embedding vector.

walk_length.description: Number of nodes in each random walk.

walks_per_node.description: Random walks started from each node.

window.description: How many steps apart on a walk two nodes can be and still count as context for each other.

epochs.description: Training passes over the walk data.
